messages:
incident-bot: AUTOPAGER fired for service=canary-deploy severity=high — PagerDuty INC-9234. Trigger: 5xx rate > 8% across canary region eu-west-1, p95 latency spike, rollout id=rl-2026-03-15-17. Check /ops/runbooks/canary-fail.

erin (eng-oncall): acked. joining bridge now. can someone grab the canary nodes? :rotating_light:

sam (infra): on it — pulling k8s logs. seeing `OOMKilled` on canary-quant-2 and 503s on the edge-proxy. pods:
```
canary-quant-0 Ready 1/1
canary-quant-1 CrashLoopBackOff
canary-quant-2 OOMKilled
edge-proxy-1 2/2
edge-proxy-2 0/2 (503s)
```

maria (sre): metrics show kv-cache miss rate jumped at rollout start. suspected regression in quantized kernel change. p95 token latency from 140ms -> 980ms for canary. customer impact: a subset of calls to embed endpoints getting 503s.

erin (eng-oncall): which commit shipped? who owns the quant change? @sam, @maria — tagging owners.

sam (infra): rollout metadata: rl-2026-03-15-17 by @devex/beta, image sha=sha256:7a2f... change: `quant-kernel v2` + batching tweak.

maria (sre): runbook step 02: scale down canary traffic and divert to stable. I can flip traffic route now. Erin, can you initiate rollback if divert doesn't drop errors in 2 min?

erin (eng-oncall): doing diversion now — `redwoodctl traffic set -s canary-deploy -p 0.0` -> applying.

pd-bot: PagerDuty note: INC-9234 acknowledged by erin (eng-oncall). Next escalation in 5m to oncall-alternate if not resolved.

sam (infra): diversion applied. metrics: 60s after divert -> errors dropped from 9% -> 0.6% for user-facing calls. Good. But some background batch jobs still hitting canary-quant pods.

maria (sre): background jobs are causing the OOMs. patch in image still has optimistic mem limits. Recommend rollback to rl-2026-03-14-09 and re-run canary with mem fix.

erin (eng-oncall): ok executing rollback: `redwoodctl rollout rollback rl-2026-03-15-17 --to rl-2026-03-14-09` — running now.

sam (infra): logs show rollback progressing, repulling stable image. keeping an eye on node pressure.

customer-success: FYI — we saw a handful of customers report elevated errors (10-15 before diversion). alert sent to top-5 affected accounts, CS started outreach.

maria (sre): after rollback started, canary pods re-created with stable image. memory usage normalized. p95 back to ~150ms.

erin (eng-oncall): marking incident status: mitigation in place (traffic diverted + rollback started). estimated impact window ~ 12m. adding notes to incident page.

pd-bot: INC-9234 status updated: mitigation detected. Keep monitoring for 15m before close.

sam (infra): suggest we add an automated pre-deploy mem-smoke check to CI to catch OOM regressions for quant kernels. filing ticket INF-1429.

maria (sre): agree. also adding canary alert threshold change: lower the canary traffic p95 baseline alarm to catch latency regressions earlier.

erin (eng-oncall): handing off to sam for post-mortem and follow-ups. @sam please own incident until PMR posted. I need to go offline for a patch rotation.

sam (infra): taking over. I'll coordinate root cause + rollback postmortem, + remediation plan.

pd-bot: INC-9234 resolved by sam (infra) at ts=2951236820. Resolution summary: rollback to stable image and traffic diversion mitigated customer-facing errors. Postmortem ticket: PM-456.

maria (sre): quick notes for PM: root cause likely memory regression in quant-kernel v2 under background batch workload. next actions: mem-limits, CI smoke, canary baseline tuning.

erin (eng-oncall): thanks team. will follow PM for final customer comms. :white_check_mark:

sam (infra): closing thread — will publish postmortem in #postmortems and ping CS.
